queries:
SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a2 JOIN member m2 ON a2.link_to_member = m2.member_id) AS share
FROM attendance a
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT member_id, position, cnt, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total
FROM (
    SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM attendance a
    JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 10
);
